title: Real Research Today: Memory Palaces for Code
definition: Today's documented research behind Memory Palaces for Code.
description:

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as palace logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: Readiness Estimator: Memory Palaces for Code
title: Readiness Estimator: Memory Palaces for Code
definition: Estimates Memory Palaces for Code readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Memory Palaces for Code components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a palace hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where spatial maps monitoring, palace logistics redundancy, or code landmarks maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Memory Palaces for Code Master Roadmap
title: Memory Palaces for Code Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Memory Palaces for Code: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Memory Palaces for Code — spatial mnemonics for navigating codebases.

Phase 1 — Prove (spatial maps): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (palace logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (code landmarks): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (recall training): palace hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and developers-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
